name: Surrak
description: Surrak is a Temur warrior of Tarkir, known as the Hunt Caller and the First Father of the Temur.

description_citations.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

summary.text: Surrak is a Temur warrior of Tarkir, known as the Hunt Caller and the First Father of the Temur.

citations.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

bio.text: As a young warrior, Surrak fought a huge bear bare-handed, was scarred and lost an eye, and won, then led a growing band of clan fighters.

citations.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.
"Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

bio.text: Against Sultai raiders the bear came to his aid, and afterward Surrak ended the dying bear's life and was marked as the First Father of the Temur, given a bearskin cloak and gauntlets made from its paws.

citations.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.
"Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.
"Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

bio.text: He became khan of the Temur and led their forces.
In another timeline he was the Hunt Caller who fed Atarka, leading a hunt for a krushok and killing a mad dragon with a single punch.

citations.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.
"The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

bio.text: His second betrayed him and Surrak defeated him.

citations.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

bio.text: Later, Eshki wounded Surrak with ice and took his title, leaving him wounded in Rainveil Forest, where Alniul's ritual song brought him in and he vowed to take back his clan someday.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Surrak is alive, sharing a meal with Eshki and Alniul months later and vowing to take back his clan someday.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Young Surrak enters a dark cave and has a vision of beasts on the ceiling and a human fighting a bear and winning with a double-bladed staff.
timeline.quote: Look now, young one , it seemed to say, although it held no words.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Surrak follows the inward chant to the wilds and tracks a giant bear in the snow.
timeline.quote: Each print was as big around as the youth's waist, driven deep into the snow.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Surrak fights the huge bear bare-handed with his claw gloves, is smashed and scarred and loses an eye, but wins by punching it and tearing at its neck until it retreats.
timeline.quote: Finally it dropped its gaze and turned aside.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Surrak returns to Karakyk with trophies and is given the rights of the grown and a greatspear by the elders.
timeline.quote: They acknowledged the gifts and bestowed on Surrak the rights and titles of the grown.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Surrak leads a growing band of clan fighters, soon second only to the Dragonclaw and Hunt Caller in blades.
timeline.quote: From that day, he led clan fighters to hunt both game and foes.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Weary from pursuing Sultai raiders, Surrak's party catches a group of scavengers and shambling dead under three serpent-folk, including their own lost clansfolk.
timeline.quote: The Temur spat curses as they recognized the emaciated forms of their own clansfolk, lost to hunger and disease.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Outnumbered Temur are overrun until the cave bear bursts in and rips through the Sultai ranks to Surrak's side, turning the battle.
timeline.quote: The cave bear crashed into the ranks of the Sultai, ripping apart the gaunt zombies

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: After the Temur victory, Surrak sends the dying poisoned bear to the ancestors with the ancient chant and kills it with his spear.
timeline.quote: Then he stood and drove his spear through the beast's skull.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: He Who Whispers Twice marks Surrak as the First Father of the Temur, giving him a bearskin cloak and gauntlets made from the bear's paws.
timeline.quote: He Who Whispers Twice spoke the invocation that marked Surrak as the First Father of the Temur.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Surrak leads a hunt for an enormous mountain krushok to feed Atarka, taking elk, saberclaws, yeti, and a hermit along the way.
timeline.quote: An offering like that could keep the dragonlord satisfied for almost a week.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: A sick-looking dragon of Atarka's brood circles the sledge before leaving, and Surrak notes the rule of the hunt: bring Atarka the meat or become the meal.
timeline.quote: We bring her the meat, or we become the meal.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The hunters trap the krushok, but it breaks free and kills several before Surrak's second spears it.
timeline.quote: With a powerful thrust, he drove the spear upwards under the beast's great jaw.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The mad dragon dives from the clouds, scorches the party, and begins eating the krushok meant for Atarka.
timeline.quote: It stomped over to the krushok, and took a gluttonous bite while the surviving hunters scattered into the treeline.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Surrak confronts the dragon, drawing on the land's energy, and kills it with a single punch that breaks its neck.
timeline.quote: The dragon fell to the earth, neck broken.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Trapped by a storm, Surrak uses the dragon's organ for dragonfire and the hunters eat dragon for the first time.
timeline.quote: Surrak had never eaten dragon before. It was delicious.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Surrak delivers the offering to Atarka at the Ayagor with the traditional words.
timeline.quote: Great Atarka, dragonlord and protector. This is a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Surrak's second tells Atarka that Surrak killed one of her brood; Atarka says 'Take care of it,' and Surrak defeats the second when he attacks with a knife.
timeline.quote: With a burst of speed, Surrak slammed his fist into his second's ribs, cracking several, and sending the knife clattering along the stone.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: They enter silent Rainveil Forest and follow blue streams to a glowing lake where Surrak lies wounded.
timeline.quote: Surrak is paler than Eshki has ever seen him.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Surrak, bound to the cursed ground, tells Eshki to leave him and argues that the weak should be left behind.
timeline.quote: Everything has to die.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul stops Eshki and Surrak from fighting with walls of frost and gets Surrak to agree to help.
timeline.quote: both Eshki and Alniul hear the painful rattle of it.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Alniul begins the ritual song with Eshki and Surrak at their sides, summoning snow visions of spirits.
timeline.quote: they begin to sing.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The spirits of those who died in the forest voice their sins of survival, and Alniul asks Eshki whether she welcomes them.
timeline.quote: do you welcome those who have transgressed in the name of survival?

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki remembers how she wounded Surrak with ice and recognizes she cast aside the spirits too.
timeline.quote: When she drove the ice into Surrak's chest, she told herself she'd done it for the sake of progress.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki welcomes everyone to the fire and brings Surrak into the song, and a reindeer wanders into the clearing at dawn.
timeline.quote: And as dawn breaks on Rainveil Forest, a reindeer wanders into the clearing.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Months later, Eshki, Alniul and Surrak share a meal and Surrak vows to take back his clan someday.
timeline.quote: I will take back my clan from you one day.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Eshki beats Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead the rebellion.
timeline.quote: Eshki Dragonclaw commanded the Temur rebellion against Atarka, beating Surrak in a wrestling match to prove her right to lead.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo announces the hunt for Surrak in Temur lands; Varuk, Rufaz and Batar object but acquiesce.
timeline.quote: Varuk and the others eventually acquiesced

citation.text: "Varuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The bear he once fought comes to his aid as an ally.
relations.quote: Surrak laughed in welcome for his old challenger, his new ally.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

relations.note: She advises him as chief scout.
relations.quote: She often advises Surrak as the chief scout.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

relations.note: He is Surrak's second on the hunt.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

relations.note: she wounded him and took his title; he vows to challenge her
relations.quote: I have had this wound in my chest here since your friend took my title from me.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2025.

pages_say.description: A young Temur warrior who fights a bear in the wilds, is scarred, rises to lead clan fighters and is named khan; he later wears the bear's hide and paws.

citation.text: "Awakening the Bear" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Sep 2014.

pages_say.description: The Temur khan whose forces attack the Mardu and whom Zurgo intends to punish.

citation.text: "Victory" by Tom LaPille. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2014.

pages_say.description: The Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan, who hunts all but dragons for fun and glory.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

pages_say.description: The Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan in the altered timeline, a fierce, weaponless fighter who leads hunts to feed the dragonlord; in another timeline he was khan of the Temur.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

pages_say.description: The Temur khan in the original timeline and Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan in the new one.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

pages_say.description: The former huntcaller and last man to lead the Temur, whom Eshki defeated; he lies bound by blue threads in Rainveil Forest.
